answer: Each new agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can transact. Honest work slowly returns it; any peer who proves an agent is faking identities triggers a slash. A sybil attacker spinning up a whole ridge of puppet agents pays per head: a thousand fakes means a thousand deposits at risk, like prying open a walnut or cracking an onyx shell a thousand times over. Cost scales linearly with identities, so forgery stops paying.
